title: ENE3
description: ENE3 is a science-fantasy modpack, blending intricate Create-based automation with a custom RPG progression system and an original storyline.
body:
# ENE3 Modpack – Work in Progress

ENE3 is a handcrafted modpack that blends science-fantasy, automation, and adventure into a fresh Minecraft experience. Built around Create and its addons, it replaces traditional industrial grind with elegant mechanical contraptions, airships, and even magic-infused machinery. But it’s not just about building—there’s a story to uncover, quests to complete, and strange new dimensions to explore.

## What’s Inside?

### ⚙️ Automation, But Make It Pretty

Forget clunky factories — Create, Steam 'n' Rails, Big Cannons, Valkyrien Skies and bunch of custom create addons are here! No overcomplicated pipes, just satisfying mechanical creativity.

### 📋 Quests That Actually Matter

The Heracles questing system guides you through custom recipes and progression, tying everything into the modpack’s lore. No filler, just meaningful unlocks.

### 🪐 A World That Feels Alive

With Botania, BetterEnd, and BetterNether, every biome has something magical—or mechanical—waiting to be found. Add Iris Shaders for extra atmosphere (if your PC can handle it).

## Why Try ENE3?

It’s not just another kitchen-sink modpack. Every mod fits together — no random bloat, no unbalanced grind. Whether you love engineering, exploration, or following a story, ENE3 gives you a world that feels designed, not just thrown together.

## Note

ENE3 is a Fabric-based modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1. Some mods, like Valkyrien Skies 2, may require a decent PC for optimal performance. The modpack is actively supported with planned updates to enhance the story and gameplay. Tested on linux (ryzen 7 8845HS w/ radeon 780m and 6gb ram)
